# Archer and Olive

> Premium dot grid notebooks, planners, and stationery products with 160gsm pages designed for bullet journaling, planning, and creative expression.

Archer and Olive specializes in luxury journaling supplies including thick-paged notebooks, themed planning kits, subscription boxes, and craft accessories. The brand offers curated collections, seasonal themes, and a comprehensive range of complementary products for journaling enthusiasts and planners.

## Key Topics

- Dot Grid Notebooks
- Bullet Journaling
- A5 & B5 Sizes
- 160gsm Pages
- Themed Collections
- Subscription Boxes
- Planner Accessories
- Acrylic Stamps
- Washi Tape
- Stickers
- Paint Pens
- Calliographs
- Moonshade Collection
- Forest Findings Collection
- Everyday Deluxe System

## Core Products

- [Notebooks](https://www.archerandolive.com/collections/notebooks): Main product catalog page for luxury dot grid notebooks with ultra-thick 160gsm pages.
- [Planners + Accessories](https://www.archerandolive.com/collections/planners): Product collection page for dated and undated planners in multiple sizes including A5 and B5.
- [Notepads](https://www.archerandolive.com/collections/notepads): Product collection page for memo pads and A5 dot grid notepads.
- [All Products](https://www.archerandolive.com/collections/all-products): Complete product catalog including notebooks, planners, and subscription boxes.

## Writing & Art Supplies

- [Pens](https://www.archerandolive.com/collections/pens): Product catalog for calliograph and acrylograph pens and art supplies including paint pens.
- [Acrylic Stamp Sets](https://www.archerandolive.com/collections/acrylic-stamp-set): Product catalog for themed acrylic stamp sets for journaling and crafting.
- [Washi Tape](https://www.archerandolive.com/collections/washi-tape-1): Product collection of themed decorative washi tape for crafting and planning.
- [Stickers](https://www.archerandolive.com/collections/stickers-1): Product collection of themed decorative stickers for planners and journals.

## Themed Collections & Subscriptions

- [Themed Planning Kits](https://www.archerandolive.com/collections/themed-planning-kits): Monthly themed planning kits and Kit Club subscription for curated stationery supplies.
- [Quarterly Subscription Box](https://www.archerandolive.com/products/quarterly-subscription-box): Product page for quarterly curated subscription box with exclusive journaling items.
- [Moonshade Collection](https://www.archerandolive.com/collections/moonshade-collection): Celestial-themed product collection featuring notebooks, stamps, and accessories.
- [Forest Findings Collection](https://www.archerandolive.com/collections/forest-findings-fall-2025): Fall 2025 seasonal collection with nature-inspired notebooks and craft supplies.

## Specialty Collections

- [Everyday Deluxe System](https://www.archerandolive.com/collections/everyday-deluxe-system): Product collection page for the Everyday Deluxe System planner and notebook accessories.
- [Accessories](https://www.archerandolive.com/collections/accessories): Comprehensive accessories collection for bullet journaling and planner supplies.
- [Journal Covers](https://www.archerandolive.com/collections/journal-cover): Product page for A5 clear journal covers and protective accessories.

## Organization & Storage

- [Organization](https://www.archerandolive.com/collections/organization): Product collection for storage pouches, totes, and organization accessories.
